stories.title: Trump administration announces global economic war on Iran
stories.summary: US Secretary of Treasury Scott Bessent has announced an economic pressure campaign against Iran, vowing to target Tehran’s financial interests across the world. Bessent said on Monday that the US would target all of Iran’s sources of revenue, including from oil. “Around the globe, our objective is to sever every economic lifeline that sustains this tyrannical regime until Tehran stands alone,” he said. Bessent warned what he called Iran’s facilitators to cease buying oil and doing business with Tehran. More to come….

stories.title: Top Iraqi diplomat meets with Rosoboronexport CEO, military cooperation service chief
stories.summary: Fuad Hussein welcomed the Russian delegation, stressing the importance of ties between Iraq and Russia
article_sentences: RABAT, August 24.

Iraqi Foreign Minister Fuad Hussein held talks with visiting chief of Russia’s Federal Service for Military-Technical Cooperation Dmitry Shugayev and Rosoboronexport CEO Alexander Mikheyev, the Iraqi foreign ministry said.

"Hussein welcomed the Russian delegation, stressing the importance of ties between Iraq and Russia and Baghdad’s commitment to continuing dialogues and cooperation in the interests of both countries," it said.
"The sides discussed a range of issues of mutual interest, noted the need for strengthening cooperation in areas of mutual interest in light of the current regional and international developments."
The minister reaffirmed that Iraq "continues its balanced policy based on maintaining dialogue and peaceful solutions, as well as on the defense of national interests," it said.
Hussein "stressed the importance of the development of cooperation to boost the potential of Iraqi institutes, especially in the areas ensuring Iraq’s security and stability."
The Russian side, according to the ministry, "reiterated Russia’s readiness to continue cooperation and exchange expertise in order to strengthen coordination between the two countries."

The talks were also attended Russian Ambassador to Baghdad Elbrus Kurtashev and was held "as part of communication between Iraq and Russia geared to broaden prospects for bilateral cooperation in conformity with their shared interests, regional and international developments," the ministry added.

stories.title: With attacks on homes Kiev admits it is unable to reclaim Donbass, Novorossiya — activist
stories.summary: According to Anton Bibarov-Gosudarev, recent assaults on a residential building and the United Russia party headquarters in Melitopol, Zaporozhye, underscore this strategy
article_sentences: MELITOPOL, August 24.

The Kiev regime is acutely aware of its inability to confront Russia directly or to regain control over Donbass and Novorossiya, regions where residents have chosen to return to their ancestral homeland.
As a result, it resorts to targeting civilians and civilian infrastructure.

Recent assaults on a residential building and the United Russia party headquarters in Melitopol, Zaporozhye, underscore this strategy, according to Anton Bibarov-Gosudarev, chairman of the Zaporozhye Region’s Civic Chamber, who spoke to TASS.
"The Kiev regime continues its attacks on civilian targets in Novorossiya and Donbass, a clear admission of its powerlessness against Russia," Bibarov-Gosudarev stated.
"Strikes on shopping centers and residential buildings, including the recent shelling of Melitopol, are acts of intimidation aimed at the local population.
These actions reveal the regime’s acknowledgment of the residents’ choice to return to their historical homeland.
Such strikes are nothing more than revenge by Ukrainian nationalists for those who have refused to support them and for those who have turned away from Kiev’s authority."

He further explained that Kiev’s attacks on civilian infrastructure are intended to leave a scorched earth, aiming to weaken Russia’s influence in the region, with Western backing and financial support fueling this campaign.
"The Kiev regime will not succeed in reclaiming Donbass and Novorossiya or in subjugating their people - who are predominantly Russian and who have made their political stance clear.
We will protect our people at all costs.
This must be understood by everyone," Bibarov-Gosudarev asserted.
